caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, stylized arrangement of four birds and various flowers. There are two pairs of birds, each pair facing one another; one pair is positioned at the top and the other pair at the bottom of the image. The birds have green, scale-like feathers on their wings and backs, yellow chests, orange necks, brown tails, and brownish-grey beaks. The birds stand on thin, brown legs. The central area of the composition features an orange vase containing green, pointed leaf shapes. Surrounding the birds and vase are numerous flowers in shades of red, orange, yellow, blue, and green, with stems and leaves. The flowers are varied in shape, including large, starburst-like blossoms at the top corners, rounder blooms, and smaller flowers scattered around the scene. The entire scene is set against a light tan background, and the drawing is bordered by a simple, unadorned margin.
title: Watercolor Design
